context:
What happened: the one run of q_max's browser tests you asked for (item 40) was cancelled at its 180-minute limit with 578 passing, 45 failing and one check unfinished. A session has read the failures from the checks' code and error lines (it did not reproduce them). What it found:
- D-187: the Undo button is missing in the Q pane after a filed row. This is the first failure. It is either a real regression or an out-of-date way of finding the button. It left the page half-way through its flow, and 14 of the 44 later failures carry the same mark, so they may be knock-on effects.
- D-375 and D-369 (chat runs): a run that departed does not have its answer stored, and a failed run's reason is not shown. Likely real product defects, perhaps one cause.
- ROWCEIL-PLANTED and METERNAME: likely out-of-date tests. METERNAME reads a title attribute that the Tip component never sets.
- The slowest check, 14-FLOSS, took 2716 s against a default of 1440, so the run's cap needs raising to finish.

Each fix is q_max work, so it belongs to a q_max coordinator. If none is running, the coordinator here starts the lanes under your word.

options.gain: Real fixes, and a clean verdict that closes c78.
options.how:
Three q_max fix lanes: one for D-187, one for the two chat-run defects, one that re-points the two out-of-date tests (red, then green). After they merge, run the browser tests again with the cap raised so the run can finish.
Before: 45 failures and no clean result. After: real fixes, and a clean verdict on the shared browser setup.
options.label: Fix lanes first, then run again with a higher cap
options.lose: One more run later, and the lanes' work first.

options.how:
Start the browser run again with the cap raised, with nothing fixed.
Before: 45 failures, one unfinished. After: the full list of failures.
options.label: Run again now with a bigger cap, before any fix
options.lose: The 14 knock-on failures still blur it, and 3 or more hours of runner time.

options.how:
No lanes and no run; c78 stays open.
Before and after: the same.
options.label: Leave it parked
options.lose: The defects stay, and the shared browser setup stays unproven on q_max.

ref: c78 (one shared browser-test setup), your item 40 run on q_max main d3a047a
reply: Answered, Oct 28 16:15 CDT: leave it parked (c); you will work in q_max and maybe revisit. Your question: were these failing before? Not measured. q_max's browser tests run only when started, and nothing ran them after the shared setup went in earlier the same day (q_max#978). The session that read the failures did not compare them with older runs, and I did not look for any. D-187, the first failure, is either a regression or an out-of-date way of finding the Undo button; nobody has checked which. c78 stays open, and no lane or run starts.
title: q_max's browser tests found 45 failures: fix first, run again first, or leave them?
why: The first failure spoils 14 others, so fixing it first gives a run worth the runner hours, and it fixes real defects on the way.
